name: Europe
overview: Scripture reveals that the nations, including those in Europe, will be gathered before Christ for judgment, where He will separate the righteous from the wicked as a shepherd divides sheep from goats. Believers are reminded that their true struggle is not against human opposition but against spiritual forces of darkness that influence the world. The letters of James and Jude emphasize the call to faithfulness and sanctification in Christ, even as spiritual adversaries believe and tremble, underscoring the reality of spiritual warfare and the necessity of steadfast devotion to Jesus.
